snippet.title: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 - DLC7 & Next Gen Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Set your sails and mark your maps. 

ONE PIECE PIRATE WARRIORS 4 is coming to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2 on 21st November 2025, along with Character Pack No.7: the Future Island Egghead Pack!
